program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed ?? 4; const gravity = 9.8; const t = time; const height = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const velocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const scaleY = 320; const originY = 360; const ballY = originY - height * 80; const ballX = 320; const motionStateText = velocity > 0.1 ? "Moving up" : velocity < -0.1 ? "Moving down" : "Still for an instant"; const gravityStateText = "Gravity pulls down"; const lane = sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 560, h: 360, title: "Vertical Toss", state: motionStateText }); const axis = sdk.axis("axis.height", { x: 100, y: 360, length: 280, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.5, ticks: [0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5], label: "Height", unit: "m" }); const guide = sdk.groundMark("guide.launch", ballX, originY, 60, "Launch"); const ball = sdk.circle("ball.toss", ballX, ballY, 28, { role: "observed" }); const vVec = sdk.vector("vec.v", { x: ballX + 24, y: ballY }, { value: velocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v", role: "observed" }); const aVec = sdk.vector("vec.a", { x: ballX - 36, y: ballY }, { value: -gravity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "g", role: "warning" }); const callout = sdk.callout(ballX + 50, ballY - 20, [motionStateText, gravityStateText], { id: "callout.toss", role: "observed" }); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects: [lane, axis, guide, ball, ...vVec, ...aVec, callout], readouts: [{ id: "motionState", value: motionStateText }, { id: "gravityState", value: gravityStateText }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, velocity, height } }; }

manifest.title: The ball stops rising. Gravity doesn’t stop.
manifest.summary: Gravity slows the ball on the way up and speeds it up on the way down. At the top, the ball is still for an instant while gravity still pulls down.
manifest.description: An interactive scene showing a ball tossed vertically. A blue motion arrow shrinks, disappears at the apex, and points downward during descent, while a constant dashed gravity vector points downward throughout.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed, then press Play. At the top, playback pauses so you can inspect the arrows.
